name: ihav
description: The ihav family of Claude Code and Codex plugins in one catalog.

plugins.name: ihav-leaderboards
plugins.description: Merge the most-visited public leaderboards of any domain into one quality-first leaderboard with confidence and Pareto charts.

plugins.name: ihav-asd-ste100
plugins.description: Short, plain, predictable replies in any language: key-first bullets, a one-sentence Conclusion, then eight fixed status sections. Rules adapted from ASD-STE100 principles.

plugins.name: ihav-agent-room
plugins.description: Native Claude Code + Codex agent rooms with shared tasks, peer messaging, reviews and native session recovery.

plugins.name: ihav-web-visit-counter
plugins.description: Monthly website traffic estimates with source and analysis date, or an honest rank when no estimate exists.

plugins.name: ihav-web-imagen
plugins.description: Draw with the ChatGPT account you already have: one line, no API key, at most one request per run, the original file saved.

plugins.name: ihav-competitor-search
plugins.description: Bounded competitor surveys, traffic ranking and official-page evidence. Live delivery needs qualification.

plugins.name: ihav-openrouter-pareto
plugins.description: OpenRouter models as quality or weekly usage vs list price, one Pareto chart per output modality, from public catalog data and the models Table.

plugins.name: ihav-auto-improve-system
plugins.description: Improve AI pipelines with recorded evidence: frozen cases, end-to-end rounds, step replays, agent review and a keep, reject or inconclusive verdict.
